ValidationRule.description: Forward moves into Drafting or any later status must come from the status just before it. Moves back are allowed any distance. Declined ranks 0, so it is never a forward move. New records are not checked, so migrated content can start at any status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Status__c), CASE(TEXT(Status__c), "Submitted", 1, "Accepted", 2, "Drafting", 3, "Proofing", 4, "Production", 5, "Editing", 6, "Final Review", 7, "Published", 8, "Retired", 9, 0) >= 3, CASE(TEXT(Status__c), "Submitted", 1, "Accepted", 2, "Drafting", 3, "Proofing", 4, "Production", 5, "Editing", 6, "Final Review", 7, "Published", 8, "Retired", 9, 0) > CASE(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status__c)), "Submitted", 1, "Accepted", 2, "Drafting", 3, "Proofing", 4, "Production", 5, "Editing", 6, "Final Review", 7, "Published", 8, "Retired", 9, 0) + 1)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: From Drafting onward, content moves forward one status at a time. Choose the next status after the current one, or any earlier status.
